   138	\section{Blueprint and formal comparison}
   139	
   140	The concrete measurement domain is retained. The scalar obligation now
   141	compares complex expectations with the complex modulus, preserving the
   142	universal constant, factor $m$, and square-root error. It is named
   143	\leanid{subline\_remove\_X\_factor\_direct}. Its distribution is still the
   144	directly indexed law represented by \leanid{SubLineWitness}, not the
   145	source law $D$. Thus it is a formalization-only obligation, linked from
   146	\path{lem:claim-17-2-direct}, and is not a formalization of the source
   147	claim. The source statement remains at \path{lem:claim-17-2}, with neither
   148	a Lean link nor a completion mark.
   149	
   150	The same scalar distinction affects Claim 17-1: an ordered product
   151	$M^Z_bM^X_a$ need not be Hermitian, so a bound on the real part of its
   152	correlation does not bound its complex modulus. The proved real-part
   153	estimate is retained as
   154	\leanid{subline\_replace\_by\_ordered\_product\_re\_direct}.
   155	Its constant is $2\sqrt{\delta_Q}$: the squared-distance comparison on
   156	one placement is $4\delta_Q$ and uses $W^\dagger W$, not $W^2$.
   157	The source Claim 17-1 remains a separate uncertified blueprint statement.
   158	Likewise \leanid{subline\_Z\_term\_near\_one\_re\_direct} retains the
   159	proved real Z-overlap estimate with its directly indexed domain explicit.
   160	No reality or distribution-transport theorem is asserted by these renamings.
   161	The three existing source blueprint statements are reused; no duplicate
   162	source theorem with a new proof hole is introduced.
   163	
   164	The distribution discrepancy is documented in
   165	\path{docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex}. Admissibility
   166	does not supply the divisibility needed to instantiate the source line law
   167	at dimension $2m+2$. The current correction neither adds that divisibility
   168	as a hypothesis nor identifies the directly indexed law with the source law.
   169	Scalar realignment is tracked in \ghissue{474} and review of PR~478.
   170	The distribution and complex-overlap work under \ghissue{118} remains open;
   171	its historical budget is unchanged.
   172	
   173	The abstract combined-line witness record remains unchanged. Its fields
   174	faithfully express the existential conclusion of the combined-lines lemma,
   175	but do not characterize the construction used in its proof. The internal
   176	consistency obligation now refers to the concrete sandwich. Both witness
   177	existence proofs construct their records with that measurement. A later
   178	argument needing the exact construction can use the consistency obligation
   179	and the same explicit record; merely choosing an unspecified existential
   180	witness does not recover its defining formula.\footnote{The Lean-only
   181	theorem is \leanid{combined\_line\_measurement\_consistency} in
   182	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/Construction.lean}. Its hypotheses explicitly supply
   183	a polynomially controlled point family. Its proof was recovered for
   184	\ghissue{512} from the saved point-to-line comparisons and pasting argument,
   185	including restoration of discarded zero-direction probability. The source-facing
   186	\leanid{exists\_combinedLinesWitness} has an unchanged statement.}
   187	
   188	The retained direct proof hole in these two modules is
   189	\leanid{subline\_remove\_X\_factor\_direct}: apply complex
   190	weighted Cauchy--Schwarz to bound $|A(T)-B(T)|$ by the square root of the
   191	X-overlap deficit, then use the already proved
   192	\leanid{exists\_concreteXPointOverlap\_deficit\_le}. That estimate already
   193	uses \leanid{combinedLineMeasurement\_sum\_Z}, expanded line-point
   194	consistency, and the separate X marginal of the directly indexed law.
   195	Transport of this argument and of the real-part estimates to the source
   196	law, including the complex estimate of Claim 17-1, is a separate remaining
   197	obligation. No additional hole is introduced for that transport.
   198	
   199	The recovered theorem \leanid{combined\_line\_measurement\_consistency}
   200	proves consistency of the same unconditioned X-Z-X measurement
   201	with the supplied polynomially controlled joint point family on the
   202	original product of line-point distributions, in every opposite placement.
   203	The construction and its discharge by the source point-to-line comparison and
   204	pasting argument are described in
   205	\path{docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex}.
   206	No marginal identity, deficit bound, or producer is added to a paper theorem.
   207	
   208	\section{Conclusion}
   209	
   210	The discrepancy lies in the formal quantification over arbitrary witnesses,
   211	not in the paper's constructed-measurement assertion. The counterexample
   212	forces a domain correction. Using the defined sandwich restores the measurement domain. The complex
   213	scalar conclusion is restored for the directly indexed auxiliary obligation;
   214	its complex proof and transport to the source distribution remain
   215	open. The source claims themselves retain their complex-modulus statements
   216	without unsupported formalization marks.

/-- The source-facing joint X/Z line measurement construction of
`lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper lines 882--894.

Unlike the formalization-only `_ofPointsWitness` companion, this declaration
does not assume a `CombinedPointsWitness` as an external bridge input.  It
quantifies the point error function and witness construction together with the
line construction, as the preceding source lemma supplies those points.

The proof constructs the line witness with `T := S.combinedLineMeasurement`.
The only remaining line-construction obligation is
`combined_line_measurement_consistency`, from paper lines 942--961 and tracked
by issue #414 in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_subline-claims-line-marginal.tex`.
Downstream arguments requiring the construction use that consistency theorem
and the same explicit record, rather than an unspecified existential witness.

**Error contract:** the polynomial bound printed in the source is carried
by `IsPolyErr₂`, which states the corrected sum form
`f x y ≤ C * (x ^ r + y ^ s)` with `1 ≤ C` and positive exponents on the
closed nonnegative quadrant, in place of the product form `C * (x * y) ^ C`
of the source shorthand at `04_preliminaries.tex:22-29`.  The correction and
the two-dimensional strategy that refutes the product form are recorded in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_pasting-product-error.tex` and tracked by issue #196.
Here `poly(ε, md/q)` is read in that sense. -/
theorem exists_combinedLinesWitness :
    ∃ deltaQ : ℝ -> ℝ, IsPolyErr deltaQ ∧
      ∃ deltaP : ℝ -> ℝ -> ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ deltaP ∧
        ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε),
          ∃ points : CombinedPointsWitness S (deltaQ ε),
            Nonempty (CombinedLinesWitness S points
              (deltaP ε (((P.m * P.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (P.q : ℝ)))) := by
  obtain ⟨deltaQ, hdeltaQ, hpoints⟩ := exists_combinedPointsWitness
  obtain ⟨deltaP, hdeltaP, hconsistent⟩ :=
    combined_line_measurement_consistency deltaQ hdeltaQ
  refine ⟨deltaQ, hdeltaQ, deltaP, hdeltaP, ?_⟩
  intro P ε S
  obtain ⟨points⟩ := hpoints P ε S
  exact ⟨points, ⟨{ T := S.combinedLineMeasurement
                    axis_degree_X := S.combinedLineMeasurement_axis_degree_X
                    axis_degree_Z := S.combinedLineMeasurement_axis_degree_Z
                    consistent := hconsistent P ε S points }⟩⟩

`Distribution.bind` is the finite uniform-mixture operation.  The two halves
law, the resulting line consistency defect stays bounded away from zero as
$q\to\infty$.  In contrast, the two-variable polynomial-error predicate forces
$\delta_P(0,d/q)\to0$.  This argument diagnoses the theorem interface; no Lean
counterexample theorem is asserted here.

The repaired conditional helper has the form
\[
  \forall\delta_Q,\quad \delta_Q=\poly(\eps)\Longrightarrow
  \exists\delta_P=\poly(\eps,md/q)\quad
  \forall\eps\ \forall Q\text{ with error }\delta_Q(\eps),\quad
  \exists T\text{ with error }\delta_P(\eps,md/q).
\]
This is not a new hypothesis on the paper theorem.  The source-facing Lean
declaration \path{exists_combinedLinesWitness} preserves its original statement:
it existentially obtains $\delta_Q$ and its point witnesses from the preceding
point construction, then applies the conditional helper.

The remaining construction target is
\path{combined_line_measurement_consistency}. For a joint point family
with error $\delta_Q(\eps)=\poly(\eps)$, it asks for evaluated consistency
of the explicit unconditioned measurement
\[
 T^{\ell_X,\ell_Z}_{f_X,f_Z}
 =L^X_{f_X}(\ell_X)L^Z_{f_Z}(\ell_Z)L^X_{f_X}(\ell_X)
\]
under the original product of line-point distributions, with error

A bound for a measurement conditioned on nondegenerate lines would not by

  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr deltaQ ∧
    ∃ deltaP,
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ deltaP ∧

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (blocker) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1053` — The new statement-level `\leanok` omits the Lean theorem’s completed optional answer alphabet, making the blueprint statement weaker.
- [ ] F2 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1038` — The completed `combined_line_measurement_consistency` proof lacks a proof-level `\leanok` block.
- [ ] F3 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1039` — The consistency theorem’s `\uses` are attached to its statement and omit the Lean proof’s direct restored-defect and error-bound dependencies.
- [ ] F4 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2051` — The extended-line proof’s `\uses` names source results instead of its actual conditional and auxiliary dependencies.
- [ ] F5 (changes) `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex:398` — Status prose still says both extended-line proofs are open and neither node is marked formalized.
- [ ] F6 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ExtendedLines/Estimates.lean:15` — Repeated “Recovered from commit … for issue #512” text records implementation history in reader-facing docstrings.
- [ ] F7 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1041` — “Lean-only construction theorem” is Lean jargon in the blueprint and corresponding Lean docstring.
- [ ] F8 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/Conditioning.lean:31` — “formalization-only adapter” is software terminology; use “formalization-only auxiliary lemma.”
- [ ] F9 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/Sampling.lean:106` — “raw direction coordinate” uses process-shaped terminology; use “sampled direction coordinate.”

## Review

F1: The Lean conclusion at `Lines/Construction.lean:435-445` postprocesses line answers using `evalOpt` into `Option × Option` and embeds point answers with `some`. Undefined line evaluations therefore contribute to the off-diagonal defect. The blueprint must explicitly state the completed alphabet \((\F_q\cup\{\bot\})^2\) and the zero extension of the point measurement before its statement-level `\leanok` is valid.

F2: The marker at line 1038 is inside the lemma environment, so it certifies only the statement. Add a separate proof environment with `\leanok`; the Lean proof at `Lines/Construction.lean:429-492` has no `sorryAx`.

F3: The Lean proof directly invokes `exists_combinedLine_restored_defect_le` and `exists_conditioned_polynomial_bound`. The current statement-level dependencies instead list `lem:qld-comm-line-cons` and `lem:pasting`, which are transitive proof inputs. Add a subordinate support node for the restored-defect theorem, use `thm:qld-conditioned-polynomial-bound` in the proof dependencies, and keep statement dependencies minimal.

F4: `Apply.lean:157-196` directly uses `exists_combinedPointsWitness`, the existing conditional `_ofPointsWitness` construction, `subline_joint_overlap_near_one_at`, `exists_combining_polynomial_bound`, and the extended-line consistency and degree results. It does not call `lem:qld-4-12`. Record the conditional helper and new public auxiliaries in separate formalization-support nodes, without placing them on a source-labelled `\leanok` path, and include `lem:qld-4-10` plus `thm:qld-combining-polynomial-bound`.

F5: Lines 398 and 410 contradict the new statement/proof markers at blueprint lines 2019 and 2050. State that only the printed-error declaration remains open; the established auxiliary is proved and marked. The same stale claim also remains in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md:17`.

F6: Remove the recovery provenance from the module and theorem docstrings, retaining only mathematical source and gap references. The pattern recurs across `ExtendedLines/{Estimates,Measurement,Overlap}`, `Lines/{Conditioning,Construction,PointComparison,Sampling}`, `SubLineXDeficit`, `XEvalDeficit`, and at `Lines.lean:61,102` and `Lines/Construction.lean:426`.

F7: Replace “Lean-only construction theorem” with “formalization-only auxiliary theorem.” Apply the same correction to `Lines/Construction.lean:414`.

F8: Replace the sentence with “This formalization-only auxiliary lemma is applied below with the proved fiber estimate.”

F9: Replace “the last raw direction coordinate” with “the last sampled direction coordinate.”

The ordered \(X\)-then-\(Z\) addition matches its Lean signature. The separate established extended-line statement also accurately records its directly indexed carrier, completed answers, and corrected error. The source-labelled `lem:qld-xz-lines` and `lem:qld-4-13` entries should remain `\notready`.
